name: María Lugones
shortBio: Argentine-American decolonial feminist philosopher who formulated the "coloniality of gender" and "world-travelling," exposing how modern-colonial capitalism invented binary racialized gender hierarchies.
centralQuestion: How was binary hierarchical gender imposed as a colonial instrument alongside race, and how can coalition across "worlds of sense" resist fragmentation?

keyWorks.title: Heterosexualism and the Colonial/Modern Gender System
keyWorks.description: Critiques Quijano's coloniality of power to define the coloniality of gender as a racialized and heterosexist axis of domination.

keyWorks.title: Pilgrimages / Peregrinajes: Theorizing Coalition Against Multiple Oppressions
keyWorks.description: Collects "Playfulness, World-Travelling, and Loving Perception" alongside spatial theories of resistant multiplicity.
